name: signal
summary: [Signal](https://signal.org/) is a messaging app with privacy at its core. It is free and easy to use, with strong end-to-end encryption that keeps your communication completely private.

ports.description: Signal desktop gui HTTP must be proxied.

volumes.description: Users home directory in the container, stores local files and settings

docs.setup:
The application can be accessed at:

* https://yourhost:3001/

>[!WARNING]
>This container does not encrypt Signal's config.json using a secret manager like gnome-keyring or kwallet, the file is stored in plaintext.

changelog.text: Make Wayland default disable with PIXELFLUX_WAYLAND=false.
Use Wayland ozone platform fixes scaling and acceleration.
